====================================================================
  S A L T L I N E   —   Beta
  A first-person survival mystery on an abandoned North Sea oil rig
====================================================================


HOW TO START THE GAME
---------------------
1. Double-click  SALTLINE.exe
2. That's it. There is no installer and nothing to set up.


"WINDOWS PROTECTED YOUR PC" — THIS IS NORMAL
--------------------------------------------
Because this is an indie game and not signed with a paid Microsoft
certificate, Windows may show a blue warning box the first time you
run it.

To play:

    1. Click  "More info"
    2. Click  "Run anyway"

You only have to do this once. The game is a single self-contained
program — it does not install anything, does not change any system
settings, and does not need an internet connection.


REQUIREMENTS
------------
  Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit
  About 4 GB of RAM
  A mouse (the game is mouse-look, a trackpad is painful)
  A gamepad works too, but is optional

If the game runs slowly, press Esc and turn the graphics settings
down in the pause menu.


THE FIRST FIVE MINUTES
----------------------
You wake in a survival pod at the waterline. The rig above you has
no power and no crew.

  * Walk out and look around. Follow the painted signage — the rig
    labels its own decks and rooms.
  * Pick things up. Almost anything loose can be grabbed with E.
  * Find the master breaker room and get the power back on. Most of
    the rig only becomes useful once the lights are running.
  * Watch the four bars in the bottom-left: LIFE, HUNGER, THIRST,
    WARMTH. Eat, drink, and stay dry and warm.
  * When a storm rolls in, get inside.


CONTROLS
--------
  MOVEMENT
    W A S D ............ move
    Mouse .............. look
    Shift .............. sprint
    Space .............. jump
    Ctrl ............... crouch (quieter, harder for creatures to spot)

  INTERACTION
    E .................. interact / pick up / set down
    Hold E on ladder ... climb  (E up, E+S down, release to let go)
    LMB ................ throw the item you are carrying
    F .................. throw the rigging hook

  ITEMS
    1 – 4 .............. select an item into your hand
    Same number again .. eat / drink / use it
    I .................. inventory
    J .................. journal
    H .................. help
    Esc ................ pause and settings


WHAT TO DO ON THE RIG
---------------------
  POWER      Find the master breaker room and restore the grid.
             Lights, the stove, and the fridge all depend on it.

  CRAFTING   Press E at a rigging bench. Lay parts from your pack
             onto the bench; when they match a recipe, hold WORK or
             Space to build it. A partial layout will tell you what
             it wants to become and what is still missing.

  BUILDING   Press B while carrying a crafted kit. A ghost preview
             snaps to the deck grid. LMB places, R rotates,
             Tab or scroll cycles kits, B or Esc exits.

  FISHING    The rod is in the wet-deck storeroom — read the
             Angler's Notes beside it, they list every species and
             the hours, water and weather it runs in.
             LMB casts. When the float plunges, LMB strikes, then
             hold LMB to reel during the lulls and release during
             the surges. Fight it wrong and the line breaks.
             Craft a Drop Net at the bench for the species that
             will not take a hook.

  FOOD       Sear raw catch at the dining hall stove (E, then COOK).
             Raw fish rots in about four game hours. Cooked fish
             hung on a drying line cures to Dried Fish and keeps
             forever, or you can stow it in the fridge.
             Raw glow worms will make you sick. Cook them.

  THE STACK  The accommodation block above the topside deck. Ramp up
             from the deck following QUARTERS, then take the internal
             stairwell up through the quarters, control, and works
             decks to the roof mast deck.


SAVING
------
The game autosaves. You can also save from the pause menu (Esc).


TROUBLESHOOTING
---------------
  The game will not start
      Right-click SALTLINE.exe, choose Properties, and if there is
      an "Unblock" checkbox near the bottom, tick it and click OK.

  It runs slowly or stutters
      Press Esc and lower the graphics settings. Closing other
      programs helps — this is a fairly heavy 3D game.

  The mouse feels wrong
      Mouse sensitivity is in the pause menu under settings.

  I am stuck somewhere
      Try crouching (Ctrl) and walking out slowly. If you are truly
      stuck, load your last autosave from the pause menu.


Thanks for playing. This is a beta — if you hit something broken,
that is genuinely useful to hear about.

====================================================================
